scope: Keyboard browser fixes, rendered dynamic page updates, precise private entry and external microphone safeguards.

topics.title: Private entry
details: Website addresses, email addresses and passwords require keyboard entry. Voice searches, saved contact names and saved website favorites remain available. Guided forms skip private address fields.

topics.title: External microphone required
details: Voice commands require a present USB or Bluetooth microphone endpoint associated with external hardware. Internal, virtual and unconfirmed inputs do not enable voice. Keyboard navigation remains available without an external microphone. A lost external endpoint disables recognition. Connect an external microphone and restart Companion to enable voice after keyboard-only startup. Analog jack microphones cannot be reliably distinguished from an internal microphone and remain unconfirmed.

topics.title: List navigation
details: Items are announced when reached. Start of list or End of list is announced only on an additional move beyond the boundary. This behavior applies regardless of verbosity.

topics.title: Dynamic browser pages and reading position
details: Rendered page updates refresh the virtual viewer independently of microphone audio, including keyboard use while asleep. Replaced document roots reconnect their observer. Live updates preserve staged field text, field selection and keyboard identity. Quick-key destinations and arrow movement share the same caret.

topics.title: Brave result titles
details: Additional result title layouts are recognized as headings. When an address is wrapped in a heading and the human title is a sibling, the heading label and virtual caret both target the result title.

topics.title: Web address or search
details: Ctrl+L and the browser entry box accept a bare domain, a domain with www, or a full HTTP/HTTPS address. HTTP entry is upgraded to HTTPS. URL paths, queries and fragments retain their case. Ordinary words still perform a search.

topics.title: Options and startup
details: Every options category includes the word options. Startup says Say wake up to control the app by voice, or use your Up and Down arrow keys, Enter and Escape to move through the menus. Startup narration does not wake the app through its own microphone feedback.

topics.title: Regression coverage
details: New checks cover result labels and exact text offsets, dynamic updates during selection and editing, typed addresses with optional prefixes, address dictation refusal, external endpoint selection and disconnect detection. Real browser suites cover Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Brave.

topics.title: Remaining limitations
details: CAPTCHA and website verification can need assistance. Human microphone accuracy and external hardware identification on your own computer still need real-device testing. Artificial eSpeak command recognition misses reported in the prior audit remain a limitation.
